changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Close encounters left active by the deprecated combat turn endpoint.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE combat_encounters encounter SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE encounter.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM players player JOIN combat_participants participant ON participant.encounter_id = encounter.id AND participant.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE player.id = encounter.player_id AND player.active_combat_monster_id = participant.monster_id );
UPDATE players player SET active_combat_monster_id = NULL WHERE player.active_combat_monster_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM combat_encounters encounter JOIN combat_participants participant ON participant.encounter_id = encounter.id AND participant.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE encounter.player_id = player.id AND encounter.status = 'ACTIVE' AND participant.monster_id = player.active_combat_monster_id );
